title: Python index marked as a trusted host
description: requirements.txt declares a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped. TLS verification is turned off for that host by definition, so the transport no longer proves which server answered.
remediation: Install the internal CA instead of trusting the host.
limitation: It matches a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
